# INA postaje – static station finder + PHP/SQL CMS

A searchable list of **all INA petrol stations in Croatia**: working hours, which fuels each station sells
(with prices), services, contact details and an "open now" bubble. Everything is pulled automatically from
[ina.hr/trazilica-benzinskih-postaja](https://www.ina.hr/trazilica-benzinskih-postaja/) by a cron job.

* **Public site = static HTML + CSS** (generated by the CMS) with a **light/dark switcher**. A little vanilla JS
  only filters, sorts and computes "open now"; without JS every station is still there, fully readable, and the
  page follows the device's light/dark setting.
* **CMS = PHP 8.2+ + MySQL/MariaDB** (SQLite for local dev), one administrator, password + mandatory TOTP 2FA.
* Design and architecture follow [plava-nafta.crodesign93.eu](https://plava-nafta.crodesign93.eu/) /
  [`idzanhr/plavi_diesel-php-cms-rebuild`](https://github.com/idzanhr/plavi_diesel-php-cms-rebuild) (same palette, cards,
  security model, deploy), extended from 129 blue-diesel stations to the whole INA network and every fuel.

```
<repo root> = web root
  index.html (+ .gz)          ← GENERATED: price overview + every station card pre-rendered
  privatnost.html, kolacici.html, 404.html, data/stations.json   ← GENERATED
  assets/css/site.css         ← light-dark() colour tokens (WCAG AA checked in both themes)
  assets/js/theme-init.js     ← applies a saved light/dark choice before the first paint
  assets/js/site.js, hours.js ← theme toggle, search/filters/sorting, "Sada radi"
  customer-gas-updater/       ← hidden admin: index.php (login → 2FA → editor), api.php, assets/
  app/src/                    ← InaSource (ina.hr parsers), InaSync, Stations, Render, Fuels, Auth, Totp…
  app/templates/              ← page templates
  sql/  bin/  deploy/  tests/
```

## What the public page shows

* **Cijene goriva** – one tile per INA product: Eurosuper 95 Class Plus, Eurosuper 95, Eurosuper 95 Class Plus Premium,
  Eurosuper 100 Class Plus Premium, Eurodiesel Class Plus, Eurodiesel, Eurodiesel Class Plus Premium, Autoplin,
  Eurodiesel plavi, Eurodiesel Class Plus Expert (the list and order live in `Fuels::CATEGORIES`). Each shows
  **two prices**, each with the date it took effect: the regular price (*izvan autocesta*, the most common price, the
  same at all stations off the motorways) and the motorway / transit price (*Autoceste*, the most common higher price,
  shown when at least two stations charge it). For a week after a change it says **NOVA CIJENA od … – prije …
  (pojeftinjenje −0,04 €)**. Each station's own price is on its card.
* **AdBlue**: listed on every station that has it, **always without a price**, and in the fuel filter. A station
  has it if ina.hr lists it (under *Goriva u ponudi*, *Usluge* or *Ostalo*, where ina.hr usually puts "Ad Blue"), or if
  the admin ticked **"Ima AdBlue"**, by hand or through an import (`adblue_have` column). Whether AdBlue can be **dispensed from a pump nozzle** is not on ina.hr, only in the
  INA Loyalty app (tap the station). The admin ticks **"Moguće istakanje AdBlue iz pištolja"** on the station. The card
  then says *"moguće istakanje iz pištolja"*, and the filter gets **"AdBlue – istakanje iz pištolja"**. The sync never
  changes this checkbox.
* **Filters**: free text (place, name, address, phone, fuel, service, nickname), county, fuel type, service,
  *Sada rade* / *Bez privremeno zatvorenih*. **Order**: A–Ž, Ž–A, by county, **cheapest selected fuel**,
  **Najbliže meni** (browser geolocation; distance computed in the browser, the position is never sent anywhere).
  Every filter is kept in the URL (`?gorivo=lpg&zupanija=…&prikaz=sada`), so a search can be shared.
* **Card**: county, closure badge, "Sada radi · do 22:00" / "Non-stop" / "Sada ne radi · otvara sutra u 06:00",
  address (+ distance), fuels with prices ("nova cijena, prije 1,73 €"), services, working hours incl. holidays,
  call button per phone number, links to the station's ina.hr page and Google Maps.
* **Light/dark**: follows the system by default. The toggle overrides it for this site only (stored in
  `localStorage`, applied before first paint); toggling back to what the system shows removes the override.

## How data comes from ina.hr (`bin/sync-ina.php`)

1. **The finder** (one request): every entry of `div#mdata[stations]` is matched to a station by its ina.hr link.
   New ones are **added automatically**. Name, phone and coordinates are updated. Address, city and postcode are only
   **filled while empty**, so addresses checked by hand or imported stay as they are. A missing county
   is taken from the finder or guessed from the postcode (10xxx → Grad Zagreb or Zagrebačka). Stations the finder no
   longer lists are **flagged, never deleted** ("Više nisu u tražilici ina.hr" in the editor).
2. **Each station page**: the working-hours table, the **"Goriva u ponudi"** list (every fuel with its price), the
   lists under "Usluge" and "Ostalo" (shown as services on the card), the contact box ("Mob", "Adresa" when the
   station has none yet, and **"Regija"**, INA's organisational unit such as ZAPAD), coordinates if the finder lacked
   them, and closure wording. The INA region is stored apart from the county (županija) and shown only in the editor.
   * A changed price keeps the old one and the date → card/overview "nova cijena", a `price_history` row and an
     entry in the **Dnevnik**. A fuel listed without a price keeps its last known price; a page that cannot be read
     changes nothing.
   * Hours table saying **PRIVREMENO ZATVORENO** every day → the station is closed automatically and reopened when
     real hours return (`'ina_auto_close' => false` to only flag it). Other closure wording is only flagged.
     Closures the admin sets are never touched.
3. The site is re-published after any change.

**What you control in the editor** (never overwritten by the sync): nicknames, a public note on the card,
*Ima AdBlue*, *AdBlue iz pištolja*, county, address/city/postcode once set,
temporary closures with dates, **Sakrij s javne stranice**, and **Zaključaj ručne izmjene** (the sync then keeps
your name/address/phone/hours/services; fuels and prices still come from ina.hr). Prices cannot be entered by hand.
Stations still listed on ina.hr can only be hidden, not deleted (the sync would add them back).

> **Check the parsers against the live site once after deploying.** This code was written without access to
> ina.hr from the build machine: the hours table, `div#mdata` and the "Goriva u ponudi" list follow the structure
> the previous project already parses successfully, while the finder's extra keys (name, address, coordinates…)
> and the services list are read defensively under several likely names. Run
> ```
> php bin/ina-probe.php                                       # finder: first raw entry + what was read
> php bin/ina-probe.php https://www.ina.hr/station/murter/    # one page: hours, fuels, services, details
> ```
> If a field comes back empty everywhere, adjust the key list in `InaSource::parseDirectory()` or the heading
> pattern in `parseServices()` – the tests in `tests/run.php` show the expected shapes.

## Deploy (CloudPanel or any nginx + PHP-FPM)

1. Create a MySQL database and a PHP site (PHP 8.2+ with `pdo_mysql`, `curl`, `dom`, `mbstring`, `intl` recommended).
2. As the site user, in the (empty) domain folder:
   ```
   git clone https://github.com/idzanhr/ina_mpm_statonfinder-gas_prices.git .
   cp app/config.example.php app/config.php
   php -r 'echo base64_encode(random_bytes(32)), PHP_EOL;'   # → app_key
   nano app/config.php                                        # dsn, user, pass, app_key
   chmod 600 app/config.php
   php bin/install.php                                        # tables, admin, station list from ina.hr, public pages
   php bin/sync-ina.php --all                                 # hours, fuels, prices, services (several minutes)
   ```
3. **Bunny CDN + vhost**: follow [Bunny CDN](#bunny-cdn) below. The vhost is locked to Bunny, so the site only
   answers once Bunny sends its secret header.
4. Open `https://lokator-benzinskih.crodesign93.eu/customer-gas-updater/`, log in, scan the QR code, save the 8 recovery codes.
5. **Cron** (`php` = the site's PHP version):
   ```
   * 0,4 * * *  php /path/to/bin/sync-ina.php     # each minute of 00:xx and 04:xx: 1/60 of the stations → two full rounds a day
   5 0 * * *    php /path/to/bin/publish.php      # closures that start/end today are right even without JS
   ```
   Add more hours (e.g. `* 0,4,12 * * *`) for fresher prices. Requests are spaced by `ina_delay_ms`.

**Updating later:** `git pull && php bin/upgrade.php`. Generated files are git-ignored, so pulls never conflict.

## Importing a checked list (Excel)

**Uvoz / izvoz → Uvoz** takes a CSV saved from Excel ("CSV UTF-8", `;` or `,`) with a header row. Any subset of the
export's columns works, e.g. `name;address;city;county;adblue_have`.

* A row finds its station by `ina_url`, then by name + city, then by **name alone** when exactly one station has it.
  Case, spaces around "-" and č/ć/đ/š/ž don't matter, and the station keeps its own spelling of the name.
* Counties may be written without "županija" (`Vukovarsko-srijemska`).
* Only **existing stations are updated**. Rows that match nothing (or match two stations) are listed after the import
  instead of being added; tick *Dodaj i nove postaje* to add them.
* Columns not in the file are left alone. Imported addresses, cities and postcodes are not overwritten by the sync.

## Bunny CDN

Visitors → Bunny → this server. [`deploy/nginx-vhost.conf`](deploy/nginx-vhost.conf) is already set up for that
(domain `lokator-benzinskih.crodesign93.eu`):

* **Origin lock.** Every request must carry the header `X-Inapostaje-Origin: <secret>`, which only Bunny adds.
  Anything else (someone calling the server's IP directly) gets **403**. Let's Encrypt renewals
  (`/.well-known/acme-challenge/`) are the only exception.
* **Real visitor IPs.** nginx takes the visitor's address from the *last* `X-Forwarded-For` entry, the one Bunny
  adds. The admin lockout, the POST rate limit and the **Dnevnik** therefore see real people, not Bunny servers.
  This is safe only because of the lock above. Keep `'trust_proxy' => false` in `app/config.php`.
* **Caching.** Pages and `data/stations.json` are `no-cache` (Bunny revalidates, a cheap 304). CSS/JS have a content
  hash in the URL (`site.css?v=…`) and are cached for a year. The admin is `no-store`.

Do these once, in this order (setting names as in the Bunny dashboard):

1. **Secret**: on the server run `openssl rand -hex 24` and keep the value.
2. **Origin certificate first**: in CloudPanel install the Let's Encrypt certificate for
   `lokator-benzinskih.crodesign93.eu` *before* DNS points to Bunny. Renewals keep working through Bunny later.
3. **Pull zone → General**
   * *Origin URL*: `https://<server IP>` (the IP, not the domain, which would loop back through Bunny).
   * *Forward Host Header*: **ON**. nginx only answers for `lokator-benzinskih.crodesign93.eu`.
   * *Hostnames*: add `lokator-benzinskih.crodesign93.eu` and enable its free SSL certificate.
4. **Edge rule "Origin secret"**: condition *Request URL* matches `*`. Action **Add Request Header** (the one marked
   *Origin*; *Set Response Header* would send it to the visitor instead and the server would answer 403), name
   `X-Inapostaje-Origin`, value = the secret from step 1.
5. **Edge rule "Admin – never cache"**: condition *Request URL* matches `*/customer-gas-updater*`. Action *Bypass
   Cache* (or *Override Cache Time* `0` + *Override Browser Cache Time* `0`).
6. **Caching**
   * *Cache Expiration Time*: **Respect Origin Cache-Control**. *Browser Cache Expiration Time*: **Match Server**.
   * *Query String*: **not** ignored / *Vary by query string* **on**. Otherwise a new `site.css?v=…` is served stale.
   * *Disable Cookies*: **OFF**. Otherwise the admin session cookie is stripped and login loops.
   * *Optimizer* and *Perma-Cache*: **OFF**. The Optimizer rewrites HTML/JS, which the strict CSP blocks.
7. **Vhost**: CloudPanel → Site → **Vhost**: paste the file, replace `CHANGE-ME-BUNNY-SECRET` with the secret from
   step 1 and keep the regex around it: `"~^<your secret>$" 1;`. Then save. The regex form matters, because a long plain key
   fails with "could not build map_hash". Never leave the placeholder: it is public in this repo.
8. **DNS**: point `lokator-benzinskih` (CNAME) to the pull zone's `*.b-cdn.net` hostname.
9. **Check**:
   ```
   curl -skI https://127.0.0.1/ -H 'Host: lokator-benzinskih.crodesign93.eu' | head -1             # on the server → 403
   curl -skI https://127.0.0.1/ -H 'Host: lokator-benzinskih.crodesign93.eu' \
        -H 'X-Inapostaje-Origin: CHANGE-ME-BUNNY-SECRET' | head -1                                  # → 403 (placeholder replaced)
   curl -sI https://lokator-benzinskih.crodesign93.eu/ | grep -iE '^HTTP|cache-control'              # → 200, no-cache
   ```
   Log in to the admin and save something. **Dnevnik** must show *your* IP, not a Bunny one.
10. **Automatic purge** (recommended): Bunny → *Account* → *API* → API key, then in `app/config.php`:
    `'bunny' => ['api_key' => '…', 'pullzone_id' => '<number from the pull zone URL>', 'site_url' => 'https://lokator-benzinskih.crodesign93.eu']`.
    Every save, sync and `bin/publish.php` then clears Bunny's copy. A failed purge never blocks a save; it is logged
    in the Dnevnik. By hand: `php bin/bunny-purge.php` (`--zone` for the whole pull zone).

**Emergency** (Bunny down, the site must be reachable directly): in the vhost, put `#` in front of the five lines
under `# --- BUNNY CDN` (the `if` and the four `real_ip` lines) and save. Remove the `#` again afterwards.

## Admin security

One admin (`admin.id` pinned to 1, created only from the CLI) · bcrypt password (min. 12) · **mandatory TOTP 2FA**
(RFC 6238, AES-256-GCM encrypted secret, replay protection, 8 one-time recovery codes) · 3 failures per IP / 20
overall → 15 min lockout · `__Host-` cookie, `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Strict`, 30 min idle / 8 h max · CSRF token +
Origin check · strict CSP without inline scripts · audit log (**Dnevnik**) of every change and every sync event.

| Command | |
|---|---|
| `php bin/sync-ina.php [--all \| --directory \| --minute=N \| --station="Murter"] [--verbose]` | sync with ina.hr |
| `php bin/ina-probe.php [url]` | show what the parsers read from ina.hr (writes nothing) |
| `php bin/publish.php` | regenerate all public files |
| `php bin/set-admin.php [--email=…] [--temporary]` | change admin e-mail/password |
| `php bin/reset-2fa.php [--print]` | lost phone and recovery codes |
| `php bin/upgrade.php` | after `git pull` |
| `php bin/bunny-purge.php [--zone]` | clear Bunny's cache |

## Local development

```
cp app/config.example.php app/config.php   # dsn: 'sqlite:' . __DIR__ . '/../var/ina-postaje.sqlite', app_key
mkdir -p var && php bin/install.php        # add --no-sync without internet access
php -S 127.0.0.1:8000 -t . bin/dev-router.php   # same whitelist as production; admin at /customer-gas-updater/
php tests/run.php            # 47 tests: TOTP, crypto, ina.hr parsers, sync (add/flag/prices/closures/locks), rendering, import
node tests/hours.test.js     # 18 tests: "Sada radi" – formats, overnight, non-stop, holidays
node tests/contrast.test.js  # 46 checks: WCAG AA contrast of every token pair, light + dark
```
